purpose: Shared painted-cardboard material for Parliamo controls, cards and book illustration
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless repeating texture tile for a paper-cutout Italian learning website, used over cream paper and forest-green painted buttons with CSS soft-light blending. Primary request: a perfectly flat, front-facing macro material swatch of fibrous recycled cardboard hand painted with dry matte gouache, neutral monochrome medium-gray base around #808080. Beautiful tangible cellulose fibres, tiny irregular light and dark pigment flecks, softly scumbled paint with subtle broad mottling, small pores, short wispy fibres and organically uneven pigment coverage. The physical printed-paper texture should be clearly visible at normal UI size yet refined enough to sit beneath readable button labels. Composition: square 1024x1024, entire canvas is one continuous material, seamless tile with matching edges, consistent density and even exposure everywhere. Palette: strictly neutral grayscale, most values between #555555 and #aaaaaa with occasional tiny lighter and darker fibres; no color tint. Constraints: no objects, no cardboard edges, no folds, no corrugation stripes, no text, no lettering, no shapes, no borders, no gradients, no vignette, no directional light, no cast shadows, no watermarks. This is a production texture map, not a photograph of a piece of cardboard.
